title: galium mollugo subsp. insubricum
intro: Galium mollugo subsp. insubricum, commonly known as Italian bedstraw, is a subspecies of the Galium mollugo plant, a flowering perennial herb belonging to the bedstraw family (Rubiaceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Galium mollugo subsp. insubricum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which have been attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified as the primary compounds responsible for its therapeutic effects.
